## Do not disclose vulnerability details here

Please report suspected security vulnerabilities privately according to [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md): `simonhartmann@mailbox.org`.

Do not attach real student data, passwords, cryptographic keys, decrypted backups, or exploit details to a public issue.

If this is a non-sensitive hardening suggestion, describe only the general area and the expected outcome.
